description: This file defines the OrganizationController class with methods for handling organization-related API endpoints, including create, read, update, and various subscription and usage management functions.

classes.name: OrganizationController
classes.description: Controller class managing organization-related API endpoints, including creation, retrieval, updates, and subscription management.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new organization using data from the request body.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves organization details by ID or name based on query parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates organization information with data from the request body.

methods.name: getAdditionalSeatsQuantity
methods.description: Fetches the number of additional seats available for a subscription.

methods.name: getCustomerWithDefaultSource
methods.description: Retrieves customer information with default payment source.

methods.name: getAdditionalSeatsProration
methods.description: Calculates proration for additional seats based on subscription ID and quantity.

methods.name: getPlanProration
methods.description: Calculates proration when changing subscription plans.

methods.name: updateAdditionalSeats
methods.description: Updates the number of additional seats for a subscription.

methods.name: updateSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Updates the subscription plan with proration.

methods.name: getCurrentUsage
methods.description: Retrieves current usage statistics for the organization.
